recipes.name: Egg & Spinach Traybake
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Toss eggs and spinach with oil, salt and pepper on a large tray.
Roast for 25–30 minutes, turning once halfway.
Rest for 3 minutes, then serve straight from the tray.

recipes.name: Egg & Banana Skillet
steps: Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium heat.
Add eggs and cook for 3–4 minutes until it takes on colour.
Stir in bananas and milk and cook until everything is hot through.
Season with salt and pepper and serve straight from the pan.

Season with salt and pepper; blend half of it if you like it thicker.

aiRecords.text:
Egg & Spinach Traybake
Eggs 2 pieces
Spinach 1 bag
Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Toss eggs and spinach with oil, salt and pepper on a large tray.
Roast for 25–30 minutes, turning once halfway.
Rest for 3 minutes, then serve straight from the tray.

Egg & Spinach Traybake
Eggs 2 pieces
Spinach 1 bag
Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Toss eggs and spinach with oil, salt and pepper on a large tray.
Roast for 25–30 minutes, turning once halfway.
Rest for 3 minutes, then serve straight from the tray.

Egg & Banana Skillet
Eggs 2 pieces
Bananas 0.5 bunch
Milk 0.3 L
Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium heat.
Add eggs and cook for 3–4 minutes until it takes on colour.
Stir in bananas and milk and cook until everything is hot through.
Season with salt and pepper and serve straight from the pan.

Egg & Milk Skillet
Eggs 2 pieces
Milk 0.3 L
Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium heat.
Add eggs and cook for 3–4 minutes until it takes on colour.
Stir in milk and cook until everything is hot through.
Season with salt and pepper and serve straight from the pan.

Spinach & Yoghurt Traybake
Spinach 1 bag
Yoghurt 0.5 tub
Heat the oven to 200 °C.
Toss spinach and yoghurt with oil, salt and pepper on a large tray.
Roast for 25–30 minutes, turning once halfway.
Rest for 3 minutes, then serve straight from the tray.

Tomatoe & Potatoe Skillet
Tomatoes 2 pieces
Potatoes 2 pieces
Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium heat.
Add tomatoes and cook for 3–4 minutes until it takes on colour.
Stir in potatoes and cook until everything is hot through.
Season with salt and pepper and serve straight from the pan.

Chicken Thigh & Egg Skillet
Chicken thighs 250 g
Eggs 2 pieces
Spinach 200 g
Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium heat.
Add chicken thighs and cook for 3–4 minutes until it takes on colour.
Stir in eggs and spinach and cook until everything is hot through.
Season with salt and pepper and serve straight from the pan.

Garlic & Potatoe Soup
Garlic 2 pieces
Potatoes 2 pieces
Warm a little oil in a pot and soften garlic for 4 minutes.
Add potatoes and cover with about 1 litre of water.
Simmer gently for 20 minutes, until everything is tender.
Season with salt and pepper; blend half of it if you like it thicker.

Garlic & Potatoe Bowl
Garlic 2 pieces
Potatoes 2 pieces
Prepare garlic: slice, cook or warm it as needed.
Arrange with potatoes in two bowls.
Dress with oil, salt and pepper.
Toss at the table and eat straight away.

Garlic & Potatoe Stir-fry
Garlic 2 pieces
Potatoes 2 pieces
Cut garlic and potatoes into bite-size pieces.
Heat oil in a wok until shimmering and fry garlic first for 3 minutes.
Add everything else and toss over high heat for another 3–4 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and serve.

Potatoe Soup
Potatoes 2 pieces
Warm a little oil in a pot and soften potatoes for 4 minutes.
Add the rest and cover with about 1 litre of water.
Simmer gently for 20 minutes, until everything is tender.
Season with salt and pepper; blend half of it if you like it thicker.

Potatoe Bowl
Potatoes 2 pieces
Prepare potatoes: slice, cook or warm it as needed.
Arrange with any staples you have in two bowls.
Dress with oil, salt and pepper.
Toss at the table and eat straight away.

Garlic & Potatoe Skillet
Garlic 2 pieces
Potatoes 2 pieces
Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium heat.
Add garlic and cook for 3–4 minutes until it takes on colour.
Stir in potatoes and cook until everything is hot through.
Season with salt and pepper and serve straight from the pan.

Chicken Breast & Garlic Soup
Chicken breast 2 pieces
Garlic 2 pieces
Potatoes 2 pieces
Warm a little oil in a pot and soften chicken breast for 4 minutes.
Add garlic and potatoes and cover with about 1 litre of water.
Simmer gently for 20 minutes, until everything is tender.
Season with salt and pepper; blend half of it if you like it thicker.
